market.title: ICE wasted millions in rush to expand detention, government watchdog finds
market.summary: ICE has received more than $75 billion to expand operations since President Trump returned to office — and wasted millions on scaled-back and mismanaged projects, a new GAO report found. Why it matters: In rushing to execute Trump's mass deportation agenda, the agency failed to properly develop a strategic plan, according to the Government Accountability Office report. Driving the news: The report found that ICE invested billions in six new initiatives without conducting necessary analyses. The report concluded that "[i]n the absence of a comprehensive strategic plan to guide detention expansion, ICE has wasted funds on unsuccessful detention initiatives and lacks important information about the long-term affordability of its investments." For example, the agency purchased more than $2.5 billion in detention facilities and warehouses but didn't calculate how much the properties would cost to maintain after the first three years, when its current federal funding will expire without additional congressional authorization. Catch up quick: ICE received an unprecedented amount of money to bolster operations, including $45 billion through the One Big Beautiful Bill in 2025 and more than $31 billion from the Secure America Act in June 2026. That additional funding helped increase ICE's daily detained population by 71% between January 2025 and July 2026. By the numbers: ICE rushed to purchase 11 warehouses to be converted into immigration facilities, but in June 2026, ICE officials told GAO that they were going to sell seven of them. The reported cost of all 11 warehouses was roughly $1.07 billion. The sell-off caused ICE to lose about $7.7 million in nonrecoverable purchasing costs, such as zoning assessments. ICE continues to pay utilities and security costs at these locations, costing an additional $12.8 million, per August estimates. The agency also spent $7.1 million on unneeded meals at Fort Bliss because the vendor contract didn't allow for fluctuations in occupancy levels. At Guantanamo Bay, the Defense Department spent $2.85 million assembling tents that were never used after Homeland Security determined they "did not meet detention standards." Zoom out: In some cases, the agency bypassed its normal contracting procedures, without negotiating costs. At the since-shuttered, so-called Alligator Alcatraz in Florida, the bed rate was $249 per day, approximately 171% higher than ICE's median rate of $92. What we're watching: GAO recommended ICE develop a comprehensive strategic plan, and the Department of Homeland Security agreed. But ICE projected that the plan won't be completed until Aug. 31, 2027, prompting GAO to conclude that given the "potential for continued waste of taxpayer dollars, more timely completion may be warranted." Growth is driven by renewable energy integration, regulatory reforms, energy security concerns, and grid congestion management. Lithium-ion batteries lead the market, with third-party ownership as the dominant model. Germany leads Europe's market due to its advanced infrastructure and renewable capacity. Key challenges include regulatory fragmentation, raw material dependency, and permitting delays.

North America leads with 44% market share, while Asia-Pacific is the fastest-growing region. Key players include AbbVie, Johnson & Johnson, Pfizer, Novartis, and Roche.

headlines.title: AI-Driven Innovation Reshapes Vaccine Adjuvant Discovery as Investment Surges Across Public and Private Sectors
headlines.summary: Artificial intelligence is accelerating vaccine adjuvant discovery and optimization, with over $140M in disclosed funding signaling a structural market shift. The SAFFRON global study and SANOVO China study both demonstrated statistically significant and clinically meaningful improvements in progression-free survival and overall survival compared to chemotherapy and osimertinib monotherapy, respectively. The all-oral, chemo-free combination has been selected for high-profile oral presentations including a Presidential Symposium.

Analysts project strong earnings growth with EPS expected to increase 65.14% and revenue up 56.19% year-over-year. The company holds a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) with a Forward P/E of 15.53, trading at a discount to its industry average.

headlines.title: Is It Worth Investing in NextEra (NEE) Based on Wall Street's Bullish Views?
headlines.summary: While Wall Street analysts maintain a bullish average brokerage recommendation (ABR) of 2.00 (Buy) for NextEra Energy with 55% Strong Buy ratings, the article cautions against relying solely on these recommendations. The Zacks Rank system, which is based on earnings estimate revisions, rates NEE as a Rank #4 (Sell) due to a 0.1% decline in consensus earnings estimates over the past month. The article argues that brokerage analysts often exhibit positive bias due to vested interests, making the Zacks Rank a more reliable indicator of near-term stock performance.

headlines.title: New Era Energy & Digital, Inc. (NUAI) Moves 30.6% Higher: Will This Strength Last?
headlines.summary: New Era Energy & Digital (NUAI) surged 30.6% following announcement of a 20-year power purchase agreement with Vistra for 200-207 MW of power for its Texas Critical Data Center project. However, the company faces headwinds with expected quarterly losses of $0.11 per share (up 45% year-over-year) and declining revenues. With unchanged earnings estimates over the past 30 days and a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold), analysts question whether the recent rally can sustain.

headlines.title: Should You Invest in the iShares U.S. Utilities ETF (IDU)?
headlines.summary: The iShares U.S. Utilities ETF (IDU) is a passively managed fund with $1.35 billion in assets tracking the Dow Jones U.S. Utilities Index. With a 0.38% expense ratio and 2.49% dividend yield, it offers diversified exposure to the utilities sector but has underperformed year-to-date, declining 2.57%. The fund holds 49 stocks with top positions in NextEra Energy (11.1%), Southern Company, and Duke Energy. Alternatives like Vanguard Utilities ETF (VPU) and State Street Utilities SPDR (XLU) offer lower expense ratios.

headlines.title: Mplify Announces Winners of the 2026 NaaS Excellence Awards
headlines.summary: Mplify announced the winners of its 2026 NaaS Excellence Awards, recognizing organizations advancing Network-as-a-Service, automation, and AI-ready digital infrastructure. Major winners include PCCW Global (NaaS Service Provider of the Year), Lumen Technologies (North America), Equinix (Interconnection Infrastructure Leadership), and Tata Communications (Secure NaaS Leadership). Professional awards honored Ron Insler (RAD), Jeremy Villalobos (Orchest Technologies), Dan Pitt (Palo Alto), and Pascal Menezes (Mplify).

headlines.title: Prologis (PLD) Falls More Steeply Than Broader Market: What Investors Need to Know

headlines.title: Germany Chemical Licensing Market Outlook Report 2026-2031 | Demand for Compliant, Sustainable Processes Creates Licensing Opportunities in Petrochemicals and Pharma, Global IP Monetization, and Research Partnerships
headlines.summary: Germany's chemical licensing market is projected to grow from USD 1.2 billion in 2026 to USD 1.3 billion by 2031, with a CAGR of 1.6%. headlines.title: Battery Packaging Market Expands as EV Gigafactories and Grid-Scale Energy Storage Reshape Protection Requirements
headlines.summary: The global battery packaging market is projected to grow from USD 39.8 billion in 2025 to USD 118.7 billion by 2035 at a CAGR of 11.57%, driven by electric vehicle production expansion, grid-scale energy storage deployment, and next-generation battery formats. Cardboard/paperboard dominates the material segment (61.23% share), while cylindrical packaging leads with prismatic growing fastest. Electric vehicles represent the fastest-growing end-use segment at 14.18% CAGR, with Asia Pacific holding 41.28% of global market share.

headlines.title: Can Newmont's Record Free Cash Flow Momentum Carry Into Q3?
headlines.summary: Newmont Corporation reported record second-quarter free cash flow of $2.2 billion, up 29% year-over-year, driven by operational efficiency and higher gold prices. headlines.summary: Agnico Eagle Mines (AEM) returned a record $625 million to shareholders in Q2 2026, supported by record free cash flow of $1.3 billion. headlines.title: Here's What Makes APD Stock an Attractive Investment Option Now

QS.title: U.S. Advanced Battery Market Set for Massive Growth Through 2031, Driven by EV Adoption, Energy Storage Demand and Domestic Manufacturing Investments
QS.summary: The U.S. advanced battery market is projected to grow from $38.7 billion in 2026 to $90.3 billion by 2031 (18.5% CAGR), driven by federal incentives, EV adoption, grid-scale energy storage deployment, and domestic manufacturing investments. Federal policies like the Inflation Reduction Act and Section 45X credits are accelerating domestic battery production, while critical mineral supply chain dependencies remain a key risk.

VWAGY.title: VWAGY Flags Major Charges as Porsche and China Pressure Hits Profit
VWAGY.summary: Volkswagen AG announced approximately €10 billion in one-time charges for 2026, primarily driven by a €6 billion Porsche goodwill impairment. The company slashed its 2026 operating margin guidance to up to 1% from 4-5.5%, citing weakness in China, U.S. tariffs, and competition from Asian automakers. The automaker's Future Plan 2030 includes 50,000 job cuts and portfolio streamlining to improve competitiveness.

BYAH.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges Park Ha Biological Technology Co., Ltd. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
BYAH.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Park Ha Biological Technology Co., Ltd. (NASDAQ: BYAH) alleging securities fraud. The complaint claims the company made false and misleading statements, failed to disclose a fraudulent stock promotion and market manipulation scheme involving social media misinformation, and intentionally structured its IPO with an extremely low public float to facilitate manipulation. Investors who purchased Park Ha securities between December 27, 2024 and July 8, 2025 are encouraged to join the case, with a lead plaintiff deadline of September 28, 2026.

BYAH.title: PHH, BYAH DEADLINE: ROSEN, NATIONAL INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Park Ha Biological Technology Co., Ltd. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important September 28 Deadline in Securities Class Action - PHH, BYAH
BYAH.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against Park Ha Biological Technology Co., Ltd. for allegedly making materially false statements and failing to disclose a fraudulent stock promotion scheme involving social media misinformation and artificially manipulated trading activity. Investors who purchased securities between December 27, 2024 and July 8, 2025 are encouraged to seek legal counsel before the September 28, 2026 lead plaintiff deadline.

CRCT.title: Cricut® Launches a New Category with the All-New Cricut StickerPix™ Line, Bringing Personalized Sticker Making into Its Creativity Platform
CRCT.summary: Cricut announced the launch of Cricut StickerPix Print + Cut and Cricut StickerPix Print machines, expanding its creativity platform into at-home sticker making and photo printing. The Print + Cut model ($299) offers printing, laminating, and precision cutting in one machine, while the Print model ($169) handles pre-cut stickers and photo prints. Both machines use dye-sublimation technology and integrate with Cricut's Design Space software. Products became available September 24, 2026, with exclusive retail availability at Cricut.com and Michaels for the first week.

BROS.title: SBUX's Digital Menu Rollout Nears 90%: Can It Lift Afternoon Sales?
BROS.summary: Starbucks is rolling out digital menu boards to 80-90% of stores by September to boost afternoon daypart sales through improved merchandising and product innovation. The strategy includes promoting Refreshers (showing double-digit growth) and food items, with Q3 results showing 7.9% comparable sales growth and record food attachment. However, competitors McDonald's and Dutch Bros are also aggressively targeting afternoon occasions with beverage innovation.

DNA.title: AI-Driven Innovation Reshapes Vaccine Adjuvant Discovery as Investment Surges Across Public and Private Sectors
DNA.summary: Artificial intelligence is accelerating vaccine adjuvant discovery and optimization, with over $140M in disclosed funding signaling a structural market shift. Major investments include Pfizer and NVIDIA's $80M joint venture into CytoReason and Ginkgo Bioworks' $31M contract with SaponiQx. AI tools are addressing key bottlenecks in antigen-adjuvant optimization and immune response prediction, supported by government initiatives globally. However, regulatory fragmentation, infrastructure gaps, and a shortage of AI-immunology talent remain challenges.

DNA.title: Ginkgo Bioworks Holdings, Inc. (DNA) Sees a More Significant Dip Than Broader Market: Some Facts to Know
DNA.summary: Ginkgo Bioworks (DNA) declined 8.43% in trading, significantly underperforming the broader market. The stock has gained 24.27% over the past month but faces headwinds with expected earnings of -$0.58 per share and projected revenue decline of 47.22% year-over-year. IMDCY.summary: The global AI in drug discovery market is projected to grow from USD 2.55 billion in 2025 to USD 31.79 billion by 2035, expanding at a 28.70% CAGR. Lead optimization and oncology applications are driving adoption, with pharmaceutical companies and biotech firms leading investment. Strategic partnerships and funding rounds, including Isomorphic Labs' $600 million raise and Takeda's $1.7 billion collaboration with Iambic Therapeutics, are accelerating market growth.

HCKT.title: Sirion Named CLM Technical Value Leader for Seventh Consecutive Assessment Cycle
HCKT.summary: Sirion has been named Technical Value Leader in Contract Lifecycle Management by The Hackett Group's Fall 2026 SolutionMap, ranking highest in functional breadth and depth among 33 CLM providers evaluated. The recognition marks the seventh consecutive assessment cycle for this distinction. Sirion's AI-native platform manages over 7 million contracts worth nearly $800 billion globally.

RKGRY.title: Renk Group AG: Veröffentlichung gemäß § 40 Abs. 1 WpHG mit dem Ziel der europaweiten Verbreitung
RKGRY.summary: Renk Group AG issued a regulatory disclosure according to Article 40 (1) of the German Securities Trading Act (WpHG) regarding shareholder voting rights. RKGRY.summary: Renk Group AG issued a regulatory notification according to Article 40 (1) of the German Securities Trading Act (WpHG) for Europe-wide distribution. BAFN.title: BayFirst Elects Twelve Directors to its Board of Directors
BAFN.summary: BayFirst Financial Corp. announced the election of twelve directors to its Board of Directors during its Annual Shareholder Meeting on September 22, 2026. CEO Alfred Rogers expressed confidence in the newly elected board and emphasized the company's focus on executing strategic priorities, strengthening its community banking platform, and serving customers. The company, which operates twelve banking offices in the Tampa Bay-Sarasota region, had $1.13 billion in total assets as of June 30, 2026.

NGVT.title: Global Activated Carbon Market Outlook 2026-2033: Water Treatment, Air Purification and Emissions Control Demand Surges
NGVT.summary: The global activated carbon market is projected to grow from USD 6.1 billion in 2026 to USD 11.1 billion by 2033, with a CAGR of 8.90%. Growth is driven by stricter environmental regulations, increased water treatment infrastructure investment, and rising demand for air purification and industrial applications, particularly in Asia-Pacific.

ADBE.title: ADBE Expands AI Customer Experience Push With Jet2: What's Ahead?
ADBE.summary: Adobe announced a multi-year strategic partnership with travel company Jet2 to deploy its AI-powered customer experience solutions, including CX Enterprise, Firefly Foundry, and Brand Intelligence. Adobe's AI-first ARR exceeded $650M in Q3 fiscal 2026, growing over 150% year-over-year. However, Adobe faces intensifying competition from Microsoft and Salesforce in AI-powered customer engagement, with both rivals expanding their agentic AI capabilities and gaining significant enterprise adoption.

DIS.title: NCAA Basketball Finals 2026 Post-Event Analysis Highlights Fan Engagement, Sponsorship Growth and Emerging Media Opportunities
DIS.summary: The 2026 NCAA Basketball Finals demonstrated strong commercial performance with record men's viewership (18.30 million average), 15-16% growth in women's championship audiences, sold-out Final Four tickets, and sustained sponsorship value from major corporate partners. Long-term sponsorship agreements and expanded international media rights, particularly Disney's $920 million women's basketball deal through 2032, underscore March Madness's position as a valuable sports property.

SIEGY.title: $20.35 Billion Pressurized Water Reactors Market Outlook, 2031
SIEGY.summary: The global Pressurized Water Reactor (PWR) market is expected to expand at a 4.31% CAGR from $15.8 billion in 2025 to $20.35 billion by 2031, driven by decarbonization mandates, reactor life extensions, and new builds in industrializing nations. However, the market faces significant challenges from massive upfront capital costs and extended project timelines. Small Modular Reactors (SMRs) and Generation III+ upgrades represent key growth opportunities, though state-supported entities dominate new construction globally.

SIEGY.title: MES Market to Nearly Double to US$43 Billion by 2036 as Manufacturers Prioritize SaaS, AI Readiness, and Data Context
SIEGY.summary: ABI Research forecasts the Manufacturing Execution System (MES) market will grow from US$22 billion in 2026 to US$43 billion by 2036, expanding at a 7.6% CAGR. The growth is driven by SaaS deployments and manufacturers' shift toward modular, interoperable platforms with AI-enabled operations. Discrete manufacturers show stronger investment intent, with 31% planning upgrades in the next 12 months.

GLW.summary: Pomerantz LLP is investigating potential securities fraud claims against Corning Incorporated following the company's announcement of a $2 billion at-the-market equity offering with Goldman Sachs on September 11, 2026. The announcement triggered a significant stock price decline of $22.80 per share (13.7%) to $143.60 on September 14, 2026. Investors are being invited to join the class action investigation.

GLW.title: Ciena Expands Global Subsea Footprint With ACE & ECHO Upgrades
GLW.summary: Ciena Corporation has secured two major subsea cable deployments: upgrading the 17,000-km ACE route with 30+ Tb/s capacity using its WL6e technology, and deploying WL6e on FLAG's ECHO trans-Pacific cable system. The company's WL6e adoption has surpassed WL5e, and its disaggregated line systems hold roughly 70% market share. Ciena trades at a forward P/E of 37.35 and holds a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) rating.

GLW.summary: A $1,000 investment in Corning (GLW) made in September 2016 would be worth $6,924.22 by September 2026, representing a 592.42% gain, significantly outperforming the S&P 500's 258.96% return. The company benefits from strong demand in AI infrastructure and optical connectivity, with second-quarter results exceeding expectations. However, exposure to cyclical markets, customer concentration, and tariff uncertainty present headwinds.

NBIS.summary: IREN Limited is diversifying its AI cloud customer base away from heavy dependence on Microsoft and NVIDIA by signing $2.8 billion in contracts with Prometheus, Perplexity, and Together AI in July 2026. The company is experiencing stronger contract economics with three-year pricing up 125% and five-year pricing up 70%, though it faces risks from early-stage customers and shorter contracts. With 2026 capacity largely sold out, IREN is targeting broader customer expansion for 2027-2028.

QXL.title: Quantum X Labs Files U.S. Patent Application for Quantum Authentication Security Technology
QXL.summary: Quantum X Labs announced that its QuantumQ Security division has submitted a U.S. patent application for a quantum circuit watermarking technology designed to protect proprietary quantum algorithms and intellectual property from unauthorized copying and redistribution. The technology uses Weyl coordinate decomposition to embed ownership information while minimizing computational overhead and fidelity degradation in quantum systems.

SKYQ.summary: Sky Quarry Inc. Their protocol-agnostic physical design approach leverages Synopsys' 224G PHY IP and Alchip's packaging expertise to overcome die-edge congestion, signal integrity challenges, and achieve near-theoretical bandwidth density limits, with potential scalability to 448G SerDes implementations.

SNPS.title: IonQ's New Research Shows Up to 14.6% Gains in Engineering Workloads

The research won the Best Paper Award at IEEE Quantum Week 2026.

ACIU.title: FDA Accepts Insmed's Filing Seeking Label Expansion for Arikayce

The label expansion could significantly increase the addressable market from 30,000 to over 200,000 patients.

CHEF.summary: General Mills beat Q1 earnings estimates with adjusted EPS of 75 cents, though both net sales and EPS declined year-over-year. CHEF.title: Coty Americas LFL Sales Rise 6%: What Is Driving Regional Strength?

The growth was driven by stronger prestige fragrance and mass cosmetics orders in the U.S., with brands Sally Hansen and CoverGirl showing improving retail trends. However, full-year fiscal 2026 Americas revenues declined 1% on a reported basis.

CHEF.title: Can Mondelez Sustain Growth Momentum Across Gum and Candy?

Key brands like Stride in China and Sour Patch Kids in the U.S. expanded distribution and market presence. The category grew 5.3% year-to-date with balanced contributions from volume/mix and pricing.

CHEF.title: Can Kraft Heinz's Promotional Strategy Support Better Volume Trends?
CHEF.summary: Kraft Heinz is implementing a promotional strategy focused on affordability and improved ROI to combat declining volume trends. BlackBerry projects Q2 QNX revenue of $70-75 million with adjusted EBITDA of $16-21 million.

IT.title: OneLayer Named in Two Gartner® Reports on Private 5G and AI Security in ECS
IT.summary: Gartner has recognized OneLayer for the third time in 2026, citing the company in research on private 5G networks supporting AI workloads. The reports highlight growing security challenges as enterprises deploy cellular-connected devices for AI operations across industrial sectors, with OneLayer positioned as a solution providing visibility and Zero Trust security for cellular-connected assets.

BSY.title: American Shipyards Are Backlogged and Washington Is Buying Software
BSY.summary: The U.S. Navy awarded a $448 million contract in December 2025 to accelerate AI and autonomy adoption across the submarine industrial base, treating shipyard capacity constraints as a data problem. Pilot results showed dramatic efficiency gains: submarine schedule planning reduced from 160 hours to under 10 minutes at General Dynamics Electric Boat, and material review times cut from weeks to under one hour at Portsmouth Naval Shipyard. The initiative aims to extract more output from existing yards rather than build new capacity, with potential expansion to surface shipbuilding.

AIRE.title: reAlpha (NASDAQ: AIRE) Provides Pro Forma Financial Information on InstaMortgage Acquisition
AIRE.summary: reAlpha Tech Corp. (Nasdaq: AIRE) completed its acquisition of InstaMortgage Inc., strengthening its financial foundation with a profitable direct-lending business. The combined entity shows significant growth metrics: pro forma 2025 revenue increased 162% to $11.8 million and gross profit increased 215% to $7.7 million. InstaMortgage generated $4.5 million in revenue and $3.3 million in gross profit for the first half of 2026 while remaining profitable, with over $3.5 billion in residential mortgage loans originated since 2015.

WLDS.title: Wearable Devices Receives China Patent Allowance for Pressure-Based Gesture Control
WLDS.summary: Wearable Devices Ltd. announced a Notice of Allowance from China's National Intellectual Property Administration for its gesture-controlled interface patent. The patent protects the company's ability to measure gesture intensity for proportional control, enabling applications in consumer electronics, XR, robotics, and healthcare. This allowance expands the company's IP portfolio to 14 patent matters across the US, China, and South Korea, with protection extending to 2043.

The company aims to provide managed access to AI computing capacity for businesses, with its first U.S. AI infrastructure hub expected to be operational in Q4 2026. This move aligns with growing AI adoption among U.S. businesses and supports Quanome's broader quantum and AI systems strategy.

PALI.title: Palisade Bio Expands Global Phase 2b ASCENTRA-UC Program with Health Canada CTA Clearance
PALI.summary: Palisade Bio announced Health Canada's clearance of its Clinical Trial Application for ASCENTRA-UC, a global Phase 2 study evaluating PALI-2108 in patients with moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis. The clearance expands the study's geographic reach alongside prior U.S. regulatory approval. The company expects to begin patient dosing in the second half of 2026, with primary efficacy results anticipated in the second half of 2027.

BURL.title: Burlington's Beauty & Accessories Categories Lead Sales Trends
BURL.summary: Burlington Stores reported Q2 sales growth of 11% to nearly $3B with 2% comparable-store sales increase, driven by higher average basket sizes despite flat transaction counts. The company plans 115 net new stores and will reinvest $55M in tariff refunds to boost values. Management expects 3-4% comparable-store sales growth in fiscal 2026, with beauty and accessories performing strongly. However, the key challenge remains converting merchandise momentum into increased customer traffic.

A.title: Global Metabolomics Market to Reach US$9.01 Billion by 2035 as Precision Medicine, Biomarker Discovery and Advanced Analytics Unlock New Opportunities
A.summary: The global metabolomics market is projected to grow from USD 2.81 billion in 2025 to USD 9.01 billion by 2035, expanding at a CAGR of 12.36%. Growth is driven by precision medicine, biomarker discovery, and multiomics adoption, with oncology accounting for over 44% of the market. However, Q1 2026 faced challenges from geopolitical tensions, supply chain disruptions, and elevated logistics costs affecting laboratory budgets and procurement timelines.

VSAT.title: Viasat Wins First Task Order Award as part of $307 Million Ceiling U.S. Marine Corps Enterprise Services Contract for Multi-Orbit Connectivity
VSAT.summary: Viasat Inc. has been awarded an initial $42 million task order under a seven-year, up to $307 million IDIQ contract to provide fully managed, end-to-end global satellite services for the United States Marine Corps. The contract covers multi-orbit connectivity across L-, Ku, and Ka-bands, including access to Viasat's next-generation ViaSat-3 satellites, with 24x7x365 network and security operations support.

HPQ.title: Magnite Named Primary Video Ad Server and a Programmatic Technology Provider for HP TV+
HPQ.summary: Magnite announced it will serve as the primary video ad server and programmatic technology provider for HP TV+, HP's free ad-supported streaming service for PCs. The partnership enables advertisers to access programmatic demand across HP TV+ inventory and leverage audience intelligence through Magnite's ClearLine Curation, which offers nearly 100 pre-built audience segments or custom segments based on PC behavior data.

ORKA.title: Oruka Therapeutics Announces Positive Week 28 Data for ORKA-001 from the Ongoing EVERLAST-A Trial Showing Deepening of Responses Without Additional Dosing
ORKA.summary: Oruka Therapeutics reported positive Week 28 interim data from its EVERLAST-A Phase 2a trial of ORKA-001, an IL-23p19 monoclonal antibody for plaque psoriasis. The drug demonstrated deepening clinical responses with 71.4% of patients achieving PASI 100 (complete skin clearance) and 87.3% achieving PASI 90, six months after the last dose with no additional dosing beyond Week 4. The drug maintained a favorable safety profile consistent with the IL-23 class. Full 52-week data is expected in December 2026.

GXO.title: GXO Begins Deployment of Labor Management System to Advance Productivity and Operational Excellence across Global Footprint
GXO.summary: GXO Logistics announced global pilots of a new Labor Management System (LMS) across North America, Continental Europe, and the UK & Ireland to enhance workforce planning and operational efficiency. The system provides real-time visibility into labor performance and standardized performance metrics. GXO expects to scale the LMS platform across its global network in 2027 as part of its broader strategy to standardize best practices and strengthen operational excellence.

BSET.summary: MillerKnoll reported Q3 2026 earnings of $0.53 per share, beating consensus estimates of $0.35 by 51.43%, but missed revenue expectations with $923.4 million versus the estimated figure. KMX.summary: AutoZone reported Q3 2026 earnings of $56.05 per share, beating consensus estimates of $54.54 by 2.77%, but revenues of $6.59 billion missed expectations by 1.38%. The stock has underperformed the S&P 500 by 30.8 percentage points year-to-date. SKWD.title: Skyward Specialty Partners with SnapRefund to Set a New Standard for Claim Payments Using ClaimsSnap
SKWD.summary: SnapRefund and Skyward Specialty Insurance Group announced a strategic partnership to modernize claim payment execution through SnapRefund's ClaimsSnap platform. The collaboration aims to automate workflows, reduce manual handling, lower loss adjustment expenses, and improve operational efficiency as claims volumes scale.

SHMXY.title: Global Metabolomics Market to Reach US$9.01 Billion by 2035 as Precision Medicine, Biomarker Discovery and Advanced Analytics Unlock New Opportunities
SHMXY.summary: The global metabolomics market is projected to grow from USD 2.81 billion in 2025 to USD 9.01 billion by 2035, expanding at a CAGR of 12.36%. Growth is driven by precision medicine, biomarker discovery, and multiomics adoption, with oncology accounting for over 44% of the market. However, Q1 2026 faced challenges from geopolitical tensions, supply chain disruptions, and elevated logistics costs affecting laboratory budgets and procurement timelines.

ARAT.title: Arax Firms Named to Barron’s 2026 Top 100 RIAs, Underscoring Power of Advisor-First Approach
ARAT.summary: Arax, a national wealth management platform, announced that three of its partner firms—U.S. Capital Wealth, Arax Advisory Partners, and Ashton Thomas Private Wealth—were recognized on Barron's 2026 Top 100 RIA Firms list, ranking among the top one percent of over 15,000 registered investment advisors. The recognition reflects Arax's strong partnership model and comes as the company manages over $43 billion in AUM across 15 states.

KRYCY.title: Koryx Copper Completes PFS Drill Program, Announces Further Positive Infill Drill Results at the Haib Copper Project in Southern Namibia
KRYCY.summary: Koryx Copper has completed its PFS drill program at the Haib Copper Project in Namibia, reporting assay results from 18 drill holes totaling 7,074 meters. The results show consistent wide intercepts with notably higher-grade zones near surface, particularly in Target Area 3 where mining is scheduled to begin. The company's technical team is focused on completing geological modeling and estimation work for an updated Mineral Resource Estimate (MRE) and Preliminary Feasibility Study (PFS), both expected to be published before the end of 2026.

RHDTY.title: Ruihe Data Technology Holdings Limited Begins Trading on OTCQX Best Market
RHDTY.summary: Ruihe Data Technology Holdings Limited, a Chinese data intelligence and marketing technology company, has upgraded from the Pink Limited Market to the OTCQX Best Market, beginning trading under ticker RHDTY. The upgrade is expected to broaden the investor base and enhance liquidity. Asia Pacific securities trading on OTC Markets reached $19.49B in Q2 2026, up 34.1% year-over-year.

MAR.title: Marovi’s Evaluation Intelligence Takes Executive Hiring to New Levels
MAR.summary: Marovi, an AI-powered executive search platform, announced market momentum by unveiling its proprietary Evaluation Intelligence engine that automates candidate evaluation against role-specific requirements. The platform combines 40 years of recruiting expertise with technology to replace traditional search firms and sourcing methods. Key customers including Marriott International, Finastra, and Total Safety reported significant improvements in hiring speed, cost efficiency, and talent evaluation quality.

HCOW.title: Amplify ETFs Files for Amplify Pro Sports Private & Public Ownership ETF (PROS)
HCOW.summary: Amplify ETFs announced the filing of PROS, a first-of-its-kind actively managed ETF designed to provide investors access to professional sports team ownership through a combination of public and private investments. The fund will invest at least 80% of assets in equity securities tied to major professional sports leagues and organizations, with up to 15% in private investments.

ELDN.title: Eledon Presents Updated Long-Term Phase 2 BESTOW Extension Study Results at the International Congress of The Transplantation Society
ELDN.summary: Eledon Pharmaceuticals announced updated Phase 2 BESTOW extension study results showing tegoprubart-treated kidney transplant patients maintained significantly higher kidney function (71 vs. 58 mL/min/1.73 m² eGFR at 24 months) compared to tacrolimus, with zero rejections beyond six months versus seven in the tacrolimus arm. The FDA granted Fast Track designation to tegoprubart for kidney transplant rejection prevention, and the company plans to initiate the Phase 3 LEGACY trial in Q4 2026.

PETV.title: Michael Handley Joins PetVivo Holdings, Inc. Board of Directors
PETV.summary: PetVivo Holdings, Inc. announced the appointment of Michael K. Handley to its Board of Directors effective September 22, 2026. Handley is a life sciences executive with over 25 years of experience, having raised more than $700 million in capital and led transactions exceeding $4 billion. He replaces Joseph Jasper, who resigned from the board. The company continues to focus on commercializing innovative medical devices and therapeutics for companion animals, with its lead product SPRYNG® currently available for commercial sale.
